title: Obsolete Http Web Request Mgt. usage in public API (webhooks, OData)
summary: Http Web Request Mgt usage is removed from webhook and OData public APIs by replacing DotNet-based code with native HttpClient and HttpRequestMessage, while obsoleting old event signatures.
key_points: SendRequest in API Webhook Notification Send now uses native HttpClient instead of Http Web Request Mgt.
New event OnSendRequestOnBeforeSendHttpRequest replaces the pending-obsolete OnSendRequestOnBeforeSendRequestAndReadTextResponse
OnAfterSendNotification with a DotNet HttpStatusCode is pending obsolete; use OnAfterSendNotificationWithStatusNumber
ODataUtility CreateMetadataWebRequest is pending obsolete; build requests with native HttpClient
Headers, UTF-8 body, timeout, telemetry and retry rules are kept the same
